title: A scene tree with unique_ptr
description:
Build a tree of game objects where each parent owns its children.

```
root
  player
    sword
  enemy
removed enemy (and everything under it)
5 objects created, 5 destroyed
```
hints: `std::erase_if(children, [&](const auto& c) { return c.get() == target; })` destroys the subtree.
requirements: `struct Object { std::string name; std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Object>> children; Object* parent; };`
Removing a child destroys its whole subtree; print each destructor.
stretch: Move a subtree to another parent without copying it.
